gloss: delivery; something delivered; gift sent to someone

definitions.gloss: delivery; something delivered; gift sent to someone
definitions.explanation: An item that is delivered or sent to someone, often a gift or package. Implies a personal or thoughtful delivery rather than commercial shipping.

examples.japanese: {届|とど}け{物|もの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。

examples.english: I made a delivery to the neighboring house.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{届|とど}け{物|もの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{中身|なかみ}→中身：01483_nakami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: A package arrived from my mother, so I checked what was inside.

notes:
Refers to something delivered to a person, often with a nuance of personal care or thoughtfulness. While ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧ is a neutral word for a package or parcel, {届|とど}け{物|もの} suggests something specifically intended for the recipient.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {届|とど}け{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make a delivery
- {届|とど}け{物|もの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧: a delivery arrives
- {届|とど}け{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{預|あず}かる→預かる：01817_azukaru⟧: to hold a delivery (for someone)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧: package, parcel — neutral term for any shipped item
- ⟦{贈|おく}り{物|もの}→贈り物：01343_okurimono⟧: gift — emphasizes the gift-giving aspect
- {届|とど}け{物|もの} falls between the two, covering both deliveries and personal gifts sent to someone

FORMS:
⟦{届|とど}ける→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧ (to deliver) + ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ (thing)
